description: This file defines the CustomerApproval controller class for the admin interface of an OpenCart project. It manages customer approval processes, including listing pending approvals, and approving or denying customer/affiliate requests. The class interacts with models to fetch data, renders views for the approval list, and handles actions via AJAX requests.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: Controller class managing customer approval workflow in the admin panel, including listing, approving, and denying customer approvals.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method that loads language files, sets page title, prepares data, and renders the customer approval list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of customer approvals, primarily for AJAX refresh.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the list of customer approvals, with filtering, pagination, and action links.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles approval of selected customer or affiliate approval requests via AJAX, after permission check.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles denial of selected customer or affiliate approval requests via AJAX, after permission check.
